name: Never Ending Love
source:
Main character is thrilled about a new transfer student girl Eugene who instantly becomes number one in popularity ratings made by boys. There are also four other girls that make her rivals. Protagonist needs to find true love with the help of modern technology - emails and mobile phones.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角对新来的转学生女孩尤金感到非常兴奋，她立即成为男生受欢迎程度第一名。还有另外四个女孩可以成为她的竞争对手。主角需要借助现代科技——电子邮件和手机——寻找真爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
